g.text: Intrinsic calibration (once, on video 1; incremental SfM re-run for each trial)
(1) scan k1 until the reconstructed pipe keeps a constant bore → k1 = −0.33 (no ground truth used)
(2) tune the focal length until travel equals the counter → f = 806 px; principal point (383, 288) assumed
